text: Thou art worthy, O Lord our God, to receive glory and honour and power: because thou hast created all things, and for thy will they were, and have been created. Thou art worthy, O Lord, to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: because thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God, in thy blood, out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation. And thou hast made us to our God a kingdom and priests, and we shall reign on the earth. The Lamb that was slain is worthy to receive power and divinity and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.
